name: Qatar National Bank Alahly
source: QNB Egypt press release, financial results FY25, consolidated income statement (EGP million) | key alias copy of QNBA.CA__income.json (same security, same figures; the listing exposes the ticker QNBA so the panel may request this key) | CRON 20261106: earnings per share added for FY2025 and FY2024 from the financial statements as reported: EPS EGP 12.14 in 2025 against EGP 10.76 in 2024, https://english.mubasher.info/news/4547655/QNB-posts-higher-consolidated-net-profits-at-EGP-30bn-in-2025-dividends-proposed , corroborated by the same two figures in the QNB Group results coverage at https://marketscreener.com/news/qatar-national-bank-reports-earnings-results-for-the-full-year-ended-december-31-2025-ce7e58d8df8af520 . EGP per share, consolidated. The stored consolidated net profit of 30,065,000,000 for FY2025 and 26,462,000,000 for FY2024 match the Egyptian Exchange filing as reported by Arab Finance, so the EPS belongs to the same consolidated series.
source_note: Consolidated columns of the bank income statement, in EGP absolute (release prints EGP million). Revenue is the bank net banking income (58,088 mn FY25) and Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed Gross operating income (47,044 mn FY25); a bank has no Cost of Sales or Gross Profit line, and neither row is invented here. The printed lines tie: Gross operating income less Net cost of risk equals Net income before tax, less Income tax equals Net Profit. No EPS: the release does not print earnings per share and no share count is stated in it, so the panel shows an honest dash rather than a derived figure.
